briefdescription.para: Exponentiation. This is the default function, if a class doesn't define this.
PolyRing subclass implementing the Schur (symmetric-function) ring whose monomials are partitions and whose multiplication is the Littlewood-Richardson rule.

detaileddescription.para: Exponent vectors are interpreted as partitions and converted back and forth via to_partition / from_partition. Schur multiplication uses the skew-tableau recursion SM() driven by _SMtab / _SMfilled / _SMcurrent scratch state, accumulating the result into _SMresult. Used by the engine's symmetric function code paths to compute products and skew Schur expansions.
